SUSPENSION AS A MEASURE OF PUNISHMENT
Punishment  for  offences  in  the  case  of  an  employee  may  include  suspension,  provided  however  that  such
suspension shall not exceed fourteen days without pay and shall be in writing.
Punishment in excess of three days suspension without pay shall only be after a domestic inquiry.

column2: 3.   VARIATIONS OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT & DISPUTES

column3: Parties hereto agree that during the continuance in force of this Agreement, they will not seek to vary, alter or add
to any of the terms and conditions of employment, except by mutual consent .
Any employee enjoying a benefit, which is over and above the normal entitlement, shall continue to enjoy the
same as personal, but this benefit shall not extend to any other employee. The above provision shall not apply
to the consumption of electricity, where a limit is fixed for all employees.
Any  dispute  or  issue  of  interpretation  of  this  Agreement  shall  be  resolved  by  reference  to  the  Commissioner
General of Labour under the lndustrial Disputes Act, and if no settlement could be reached, by voluntary arbitration
It  is  agreed  by  and  between  parties  that  the  Unions,  collectively  or  independently,  or  their  members,  shall  not
resort to any form of trade union action on any matter covered by this Agreement or is connected therewith.
